name: table
description: Two files must change consistently: the helper fmt.pad must gain a `fill` parameter (signature line plus the line that uses it, two hunks in fmt.py) and the caller table.render must pass its own `fill` through to pad (one hunk in table.py). tests/test_fmt.py pins the new helper signature and tests/test_table.py pins the rendered output, so neither file alone suffices; applying only the body hunk in fmt.py breaks every fmt test with a NameError. pad_left in the same file shows the target signature. Four tests fail (two per test file), six pass.
